title: 對面阿姨在跳舞
subject: the woman across the courtyard who waltzes with her mop at nine every night
caption: Mandarin fairy-tale chamber-pop waltz in three-four time. A celesta playing a music-box melody, a fingerpicked acoustic guitar, a harpsichord, a pizzicato string quartet, and a clarinet answering the voice, over an oom-pah-pah waltz bass from a pizzicato double bass on beat one, with a lightly brushed snare. Small and close like a room, intimate and narrow, the celesta and the voice forward. Intimate close-miked female storyteller voice with light vibrato and a whispered spoken aside. 138 BPM, B flat major. Watching a stranger's happiness from a window and joining in. No four-four beat, no big orchestral string swells, no full drum kit, no synth, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - celesta music-box melody and pizzicato strings in three]

[Verse 1]
晚上九點 對面四樓的燈準時亮起來
那個阿姨 穿著紅色的拖鞋
她拿起拖把 好像在牽一個人的手
一 二 三 一 二 三 在客廳轉圈

[Pre-Chorus]
我的泡麵泡到一半 就站到窗戶旁邊
我發誓 我沒有在偷看

[Chorus]
對面那個阿姨在跳舞
地板擦得發亮 音樂我聽不到
她轉到窗邊 拖把也跟著彎腰
我在這邊 也偷偷轉了一圈

[Verse 2]
有一個禮拜 九點了 燈都沒有亮
我開始擔心 是拖把壞了 還是她生病了
星期天晚上 那盞燈終於亮了
她牽著的 是一個穿西裝的阿伯

[Chorus]
對面那個阿姨在跳舞
地板擦得發亮 音樂我聽不到
拖把靠在牆角 好像也在看
我在這邊 輕輕拍了三下手

[Outro - music box winding down, whispered]
拖把 你也辛苦了
